blocks.text: BANGA, South Cotabato — Several graves at the Banga Public Cemetery remain submerged in floodwaters on Sunday following several days of rain, posing a challenge to families preparing to clean and tidy the burial sites of their loved ones ahead of Undas. Some parts of the cemetery have also become muddy and difficult to walk through, making it harder for visitors to reach the graves. Nestor Muyco, a resident of Barangay Reyes, said the flooding has added to the workload of families who need to clean the graves before visiting their departed loved ones to observe Undas, the annual observance of […]...
